ce_bugs.text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:72 — Unknown usernames are skipped while the endpoint still returns success, so a partial membership update can silently pass.

app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — The existing public group-members endpoint now returns an object instead of its prior serialized array, breaking clients that consume the response without a versioned compatibility path.

app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:22 — The admin group create/update endpoints no longer accept the established nested `group` payload, so existing callers send fields that are silently ignored or fail.
app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — The unbounded client-controlled `limit` can serialize an entire large group in one request.

mrv_findings.text: P1 confidence 100 — app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` — exact page-size multiples expose an empty extra page; boundary behavior is unverified.

P2 confidence 75 — app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — `render json: { members: serialize_data(members, GroupUserSerializer), meta: { total: total, limit: limit, offset: offset } }` — the new public membership API and pagination contract lack verification.

P2 confidence 100 — app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6:13 — `return Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1;` — exact multiples of the page limit permit navigation to an empty phantom page.

P2 confidence 100 — app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22 — `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` — unbounded client-controlled page sizes can materialize every member in one request, defeating pagination under load.

P2 confidence 100 — app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — `usernames.split(",").each do |username|` / `if user = User.find_by_username(username)` — one database lookup per supplied user creates an unbounded N+1 membership write path.

P1 confidence 100 — app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:28 — `render json: { members: serialize_data(members, GroupUserSerializer), meta: { ... } }` — changing the members endpoint from a top-level array to an object breaks existing array-consuming API clients without compatibility/versioning.

P2 confidence 100 — app/controllers/groups_controller.rb:22-26 — `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` / `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit)` — attacker-controlled unlimited (including -1) limits let viewers serialize entire large group memberships and exhaust resources.

P2 confidence 100 — spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:115 — `xhr :put, :remove_member, group_id: 1, user_id: 42` — the automatic-group rejection test uses PUT while the public route is DELETE, so it can pass without verifying the actual endpoint.
